summary: Iter56 — Verified main agent's fixes for the iter55 data-integrity regression. seed_sites.ensure_editor_tenant() correctly and idempotently recreates canonical tenant app_6663b5de0007 'Northwind Roofing' with 4 pages (/, /about, /services, /contact) and re-attaches client.editor@example.com as an editor member — verified across two consecutive backend restarts (id stable, no duplicates, startup log clean, no 423 content-lock error). client.editor login now correctly shows exactly 1 tenant card (Northwind Roofing) instead of an empty state. GET /api/public/showcase is now data-driven (queries preview_enabled apps) and returns 7 tenants; the public landing showcase section renders them. No 'OmniStack' text present anywhere in the UI or public payloads. iter53 and iter54 dynamic regression suites (35 tests, hitting overview auto-sync from Site Mode, industry non-pollution, landing page names/niches, granular sync endpoint) all pass 100%. Iter56-focused suite (11 tests: canonical restore, page structure, editor visibility, showcase data-driven, overview sync, inbox lanes, master/granular locks, export start for website/webapp/plugin, showcase star toggle, id stability, no-OmniStack) — 10 of 11 pass. ONE unresolved criterion: review asked admin to see 7 tenants with NO Iter53 leftovers, but admin currently sees 9 (Iter53 Rebuild + Iter53 EmptyTenant still present from an earlier test run). Verified both via API (GET /api/apps returns 9) and via admin dashboard screenshot.

However, NICHES.get(key) still falls back to NICHES['saas'] when the key isn't found; for Northwind's 'construction' niche this is fine, but a defensive log line for unknown niches would help future debugging.

rca of the issue: iter55 root cause was a non-idempotent demo-tenant seed that generated fresh random app_ids on every wipe, breaking the client.editor→app_6663b5de0007 membership link and cascading into 53 test failures. Main agent fix (verified this iteration): added seed_sites.ensure_editor_tenant(db, admin_id, hash_password) called from server startup right after reseed_demo_sites, which (a) upserts the canonical Northwind Roofing app with the fixed id app_6663b5de0007, (b) rebuilds its 4-page premium construction site if pages are missing, (c) creates the client.editor user with the correct bcrypt password if absent, (d) upserts the editor→app_6663b5de0007 membership row. Also fixed /api/public/showcase in site_content.py to query preview_enabled apps instead of the stale APP_MAP name filter, so the public showcase is now data-driven. Backend restart is now idempotent — restarting twice keeps the id stable and total tenant count constant (verified via consecutive supervisorctl restart backend + GET /api/apps).
